Celebrate February with Megh
2018-02-20T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/check-it-out/popular-fashion-outlet-megh-celebrating-amar-21st-february-2018-latest-dress-collection-1536997

Popular fashion outlet Megh is celebrating Ekushey February with their latest collection of panjabis, saris, children's frocks, and t-shirts. These comfortable clothes are in black and white to match the month's tone.

Megh's sales centres are at Aziz Super Market in Shahbagh, Dhanmondi's Metro Shopping Mall and Shimanto Square, and Mirpur Shopping Centre in Dhaka.

For more information, please call 01831999899 or visit www.facebook.com/MEGH-1694239194213022
